rubric.question: Does one thing lead? Squint: if everything has the same weight, it has failed.
Is there a display face with character and a restrained text face? Is the scale decisive?
Is the section sequence the default hero, three cards, pricing? What is structurally different here?
Is there one committed palette with roles, or a rainbow of accents? Does the ground have a point of view?
Are there real product visuals, or grey placeholders and stock? Does every frame wrap a real screen?
Are two or three moments tuned, or is the same fade-up on everything?
Do hover, focus and active communicate something? Is reduced motion handled?
Does the phone layout have its own composition, or is it the desktop squeezed?
Contrast, labels, focus, target size, headings. The audit covers the measurable part.
If this is page two, does it belong to page one? Same tokens, same voice, same footer logic.
